```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  notify_code_owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run preflight checks
      run: bun run ci:preflight

    - name: Get PR details
      id: pr_details
      run: |
        echo "::set-output name=pr_number::$GITHUB_EVENT_NUMBER"
        echo "::set-output name=pr_title::$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH.pull_request.title"

    - name: Notify code owner
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      run: |
        CODE_OWNER=$(git ls-files --stage | grep "^\d\s.*\.ts" | awk '{print $2}' | xargs git blame -w -L :1 | head -n 1 | cut -d' ' -f2)
        curl -X POST https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${{ steps.pr_details.outputs.pr_number }}/comments \
          -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d "{\"body\": \"Hey @${{ CODE_OWNER }}, please review the PR titled '${{ steps.pr_details.outputs.pr_title }}'.\"}"
```
